state.objective: Review the remaining client COA domains: physical cash, sales/tender channels, contra revenue, other income, purchase/COGS, owner equity and closing accounts. Preserve accounting nature and identify dimension-only detail.
confirmed_context: One PT Perorangan owns HO and all sites. Site_id is a dimension. Finance and bank access are centralized at HO.
Units may access physical sales cash, petty cash and cashier float/modal kasir.
Tender, acquirer, sales channel, bank account, item, customer/order and owner can be controlled master/subledger fields.
No sales contracts, marketplace statements, inventory method, financial-statement format, closing configuration, balances or journal samples have been supplied.

cash_identity.instructions: Should individual cash box/location identity be stored outside natural GL in cash_location_id with custodian and reconciliation?

cash_three.instructions: Can Cash on Hand, Petty Cash and Cashier Float become one physical-cash GL solely because cash_location/type exists?

criteria.review: Different purpose, replenishment, restrictions and controls may justify separate natural/control accounts; validate before merging.
criteria.always3: They must always remain three GLs.

sales_bank_names.instructions: Should bank/acquirer names in debit-card sales remain encoded in sales revenue GLs?

criteria.dimension: Move to tender_type/acquirer_id; revenue GL should reflect revenue nature.
criteria.gl: Keep one sales GL per bank.
criteria.bank_asset: Post revenue directly as bank asset only.

sales_nine_to_one.instructions: If all nine channels sell the same merchandise under the same gross/net revenue policy, can nine sales GLs become one Merchandise Sales Revenue GL with channel/tender/acquirer dimensions?

criteria.conditional: Yes, subject to marketplace principal-agent, fees, returns and settlement reconciliation.

marketplace.instructions: Must marketplace and own-online sales be reviewed for principal-versus-agent and gross-versus-net presentation before merging?

criteria.yes: Contracts and settlement statements determine presentation.
criteria.no: Both are automatically identical to cash sales.

receivable_link.instructions: Should card sales create the same account as card/acquirer receivable?

criteria.no: Credit revenue and debit the appropriate tender receivable/cash settlement account, linked by tender/acquirer.
criteria.yes: Use a single combined revenue/asset account.

discount_return.instructions: Can Sales Discount and Sales Return become one contra-revenue GL with adjustment_type?

criteria.review: Possible only if reporting, tax, inventory return and approval workflows remain distinguishable; otherwise retain two.
criteria.revenue: Post both directly into gross sales without identification.

returns_inventory.instructions: Does a sales return require item/inventory and tax consequences beyond a revenue dimension?

criteria.yes: Link return document to item, tax, customer/tender and inventory condition.

other_income_one.instructions: Should management fee, bank interest, building rent, equipment rent and other income become one Other Income GL?

criteria.no: They have different operating/financing, contract, tax and disclosure natures.
criteria.yes: All non-sales income is one nature.
criteria.dimension: One GL is always sufficient if income_type exists.

rental_two.instructions: Can building and equipment rental income share one Rental Income GL with leased_object_type if contracts, tax and reporting align?

criteria.conditional: Yes, subject to contract and reporting validation.

rounding.instructions: Should Rounding Difference remain a controlled, low-threshold account rather than be merged into general income?

criteria.controlled: Keep or use a dedicated rounding account with tolerance and monitoring, allowing debit or credit according to policy.

other_income_expense.instructions: Can Other Income (Expense) be mapped conclusively from its combined label?

criteria.no: Inspect postings and split/reclassify by actual debit/credit nature; avoid a mixed unrestricted account.

purchase_method.instructions: Can Purchase Cost/COGS and Purchase Discount be finalized without confirming periodic versus perpetual inventory accounting?

criteria.no: Inventory method determines posting and whether purchase accounts close into COGS/inventory.

purchase_discount.instructions: Should purchase discounts automatically be presented as other income?

criteria.no: Apply consistently against inventory cost/purchases/COGS under the chosen policy.

capital_draw.instructions: For a PT Perorangan, should Paid-in Capital and Prive/Owner Draw remain separate natural equity accounts?

criteria.separate: Capital contributions and owner withdrawals are distinct equity movements.
criteria.expense: Treat owner draw as operating expense.

owner_id.instructions: Does having one current owner eliminate the need for controlled owner/shareholder identity in equity transaction records?

criteria.no: Maintain owner/shareholder master and legal documentation even if there is one owner.
criteria.yes: No owner identity or documents are needed.

retained_earnings.instructions: Should Retained Earnings remain distinct from paid-in capital and owner draw?

criteria.yes: Keep accumulated results as a distinct equity nature.

current_profit.instructions: Should Current-month Profit/Loss be an ordinary manual posting account?

criteria.system: Normally system-calculated from P&L and closed to retained earnings according to period-close design; review legacy manual postings.
criteria.manual: Use as unrestricted manual posting account.
criteria.capital: Post directly to paid-in capital monthly.

closing_gate.instructions: What evidence is required before removing or retaining the current-profit account?

criteria.close_config: Closing rules, historical journals, reporting engine behavior and retained-earnings roll-forward.
criteria.name: Account label alone.

next_remaining.instructions: After these domains, what must be reviewed before claiming every account family is covered?

criteria.loans_unresolved: Principal-labelled liabilities, bank loan maturity/long-term groups, leases, unresolved REVIEW accounts and a coverage audit.
criteria.none: All remaining accounts can be assumed correct.
